model.name: Exactly ONE unit-changed->notify translator — a 2nd drifted copy is the R40.84-B 4-round defect
model.description: Architect guard design (d5228cf40, PO-queued after R40.84-B): there must be EXACTLY ONE unit-changed -> notify TRANSLATOR (the owner = notifyUnitChanged). A 2nd site that builds the notify key INLINE on a msg.type==="unit-changed" match (instead of delegating to notifyUnitChanged) is a DRIFTED COPY = the R40.84-B 4-round defect (the second translator diverged, causing the 4-round re-render). The guard = check:one-unit-changed-translator: scan the NARROW hazard (inline-key-build on unit-changed), legit ViewBus.notify(viewBusKey) emits NOT flagged (0-noise). Single-owner by construction, same family as R40.82 (children-single-owner) + R40.88 (no-mkdir); an R40.88 instance (a ruling enforced by a failable guard with a per-run selftest).

discoverySource.root: R40.84-B 4-round defect = a 2nd drifted unit-changed->notify translator diverged from notifyUnitChanged.

model.crossRefNote: Prevents the R40.84-B 4-round defect recurrence (a 2nd drifted translator). An R40.88 INSTANCE (ruling-with-a-failable-guard, per-run selftest = R40.88 guard-own-stub-must-fail). Same single-owner/hazard-scan pattern as R40.82 (children-owner 9ef91a551) + R40.88 (no-mkdir). Notify/ViewBus context = R37.12 ONE VIEW BUS.
model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED (guard designed d5228cf40; check + selftest unbuilt; no stub RED observed).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Exactly ONE unit-changed -> notify TRANSLATOR (the owner = notifyUnitChanged). A 2nd site that matches msg.type==="unit-changed" and builds the notify key INLINE (instead of delegating to notifyUnitChanged) => RED. A 2nd drifted copy IS the R40.84-B 4-round defect (the drifted translator diverged).

gateRef.assertion: one unit-changed->notify translator (notifyUnitChanged); an inline-key-build translator on unit-changed => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a 2nd inline unit-changed translator -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: NAMED MEASURED COUNTS (zero is a measured number, not an assertion): ownerCount === 1 AND inlineNonOwnerTranslators === 0. The guard reports both counts; ownerCount!=1 OR inlineNonOwnerTranslators!=0 => RED.

gateRef.assertion: ownerCount===1 && inlineNonOwnerTranslators===0; else RED with both counts named

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a violation -> inlineNonOwnerTranslators>=1 -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: LEGIT local ViewBus.notify(viewBusKey) emits are NOT flagged — the guard scans the NARROW hazard (an inline notify-key build on a msg.type==="unit-changed" site), NOT legit emits. 0-noise, or it gets switched off. A false-positive on a legit ViewBus.notify => the guard is too broad => fix the scan.

gateRef.assertion: legit ViewBus.notify(viewBusKey) emits produce 0 findings; only inline unit-changed translators flag

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: assert a legit ViewBus.notify site is NOT flagged (0-noise)

A guard that never goes RED on its own injected violation = unproven = counts as UNGUARDED (R40.88 guard-own-stub-must-fail).

gateRef.assertion: the guard self-injects a violation each run and asserts RED before its real scan counts
